prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, head and shoulders, of an invented English man of about 38, his face large and in crisp focus, turned three-quarters to camera. Expensive trimmed haircut, a deep tan, clean-shaven. He sits cross-legged with his eyes closed in an attempt at meditation, but his brow is slightly furrowed and his lips pressed together, plainly not calm. Navy quilted gilet over a white shirt, sleeves rolled once, a large smartwatch on his wrist glowing faintly. Behind him, blurred, the bamboo pavilion from the photo: arching golden bamboo pillars, woven roof, rows of pale blue cushions on a dark polished floor, lush tropical leaves beyond. Golden backlight warming the edge of his hair and shoulders. Polished luxury-resort advert look.
